svg.title: Ila asks whether Golmohar can refuse while Vale states the funding consequence.
svg.desc: Ila folds her spectacles over the consent clause and asks whether refusal is possible. Vale answers without menace that the funding and permanent systems job would pause with the trial.
svg.text: Page 10, panel 2 · Opposed eye-level medium shot across the ledger
